newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares snap five-day losing streak.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares snap five-day losing streak.

text.p: Slovenian shares reversed a five-day losing streak on Friday, closing marginally firmer.
"Today there was some optimism on the market as everyone is expecting foreign buyers to return anytime now," an analyst said.
* The blue-chip SBI index firmed 3.09 points to 1,321.24.
* Issue A of drug company Lek had the highest turnover, down 1.55 percent to 26,080 tolars on volume of 672 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
